title: The library update after a restore, and its once-only stamp, are never tested
what: After an app update or a restore, the phone links the member's exercises to the newer exercise library once and then marks it done. No test checks the mark is written only when the update worked, that the next launch skips it, that a cloud copy restore clears the mark first, or that a restore followed by the app being closed still links the library later without making twin rows. Only the demo data case and one run from an old mark are tested.
expected: A test runs the library update after a cloud copy restore, after the app was closed mid-way, and twice in a row, and checks the mark, that nothing is deleted or doubled, and that the second run does nothing.
how_often: after every app update or restore
fix_line: Add one real-database test for the library update after a restore, a kill, and a second launch

title: The Exercises list's no-match words are never tested
what: When a search finds nothing, the Exercises list should say 'No exercises found' with 'Try a different search, muscle or gear.', and must not offer a Create row while the list is still loading. No test types a search that finds nothing and reads those words, and none checks the loading moment. The phone tests only check that 'No exercises found' is NOT shown for good searches.
expected: A phone test types a word that matches nothing and sees both lines, and a test checks no Create row appears before the list has loaded.
fix_line: Add a no-match search step to the phone exercise flow

title: The exercise page's own-photo swap and its no-picture card are never seen in a test
what: On an exercise page, the member's own photo should replace the library Start and End pictures with 'Tap to see your photo', the pictures should come back with 'Tap to watch the movement' once the photo is removed, and the member's own exercise with nothing should say 'No picture or steps yet...'. No test reads any of these words; only a picture-choice rule is checked as data.
expected: A phone test adds and removes an own photo on a library exercise and opens an own exercise with no picture, reading each line.
how_often: every member who adds their own photo
fix_line: Add an own-photo step and an own-exercise step to the pictures phone flow

title: Two gym plan syncs at once, and a gym switch during a sync, are never tested
what: A member's pull to refresh can start a gym plan sync while another is still running, and a gym switch can relabel old folders while a sync is saving. The journeys say a plan must never be saved twice and the 'No longer sent' label must not be saved over. The only tests check the plan-by-plan steps one call at a time; nothing runs two syncs together or a switch during one.
expected: A test starts two syncs at once and a gym switch during a sync, and checks one folder per plan and the label kept.
how_often: when a refresh or gym switch meets a running sync
fix_line: Add a test that overlaps two plan syncs and a gym switch

title: No test checks the In use screen keeps the member's name and body weight off it
what: The In use screen is held up in a busy gym for others to see. The journey says it shows only the kit word, rest seconds and the previous and next set, never the member's name, body weight or gym, and sends nothing. The phone test reads the kit and set lines but never checks those private things stay off, or that nothing leaves the phone.
expected: The In use phone test also checks the member's name and body weight are not on the screen, and a test checks opening it sends nothing.
fix_line: Add not-visible checks for name and body weight to the In use flow
